ref_speedup_note: Anchor 3.36 calibrated in oracle mode on the authoring CPU lane (Intel Sapphire Rapids). tests/ref_speedup.txt is authoritative at scoring; this file is only the in-image fallback. See tests/ref_speedup.caveat.md to re-measure on your hardware.
target_hardware: cpu (x86-64 Sapphire Rapids; pure-Python stdlib, timing-free node count -> fully deterministic and hardware-portable)
value_axis: total AST node count of the simplified expression corpus; a fold-only pass leaves recombination idioms intact and emits more nodes than a full fixpoint rewriter
